verdicts.summary: [L] states a different form; neither implies the other. [M] prints `\sum_{i=m}^{h-1}2^{-(i-m)}\delta_i(N,N')`.
evidence: The private `Gear.shawls` (FullVolume/Mark/Sages.lean:22-32) flows a reference sequence down d′ levels and shows only that W_i n is within 2·(1/2)^{d′} of it. `Gear.voyages` (Sages.lean:33-39) gets the Cauchy property qualitatively, and `Gear.spends` (Sages.lean:66-70) is upward transport. No discrepancy δ_i(N,N′) and no weighted sum Σ_{i=m}^{h−1}2^{−(i−m)}δ_i appear anywhere, so [L] proves a different estimate that plays the role of (14.58).

The private `Gear.shawls` (FullVolume/Mark/Sages.lean:22-32) flows a constant `W i 0` down d′ levels and bounds `Within (W i n) (V n) (2*(1/2)^d′)`. `Gear.voyages` (Sages.lean:33-39) turns that into `TwoFold`, and `Gear.spends` (Sages.lean:66-70) runs upward on coefficient sequences. Greps for a weighted sum Σ (1/2)^{i−m}δ_i over Finset.Ico found nothing, so the two-cutoff bound has no counterpart.
